name: Purge
title: Purge Patient Record
description: This operation is used to request the removal of all current and historical versions for all resources in a patient compartment. Defined in FHIR 6.0.0-ballot3 and provided by Repofyr for R4 and R5. Repofyr permanently removes the resources of the Patient compartment (except AuditEvent and Group) and the Patient itself, including their history.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: Status and/or results of the purge request
